flora: Flattened needle cluster (short, blunt, linear evergreen leaves arranged like a double-sided comb)
Pendulous seed cone (elongated woody cone hanging downwards with thick, rounded scales)
Branching joint (chunky wood knuckle where smooth twigs divide)
Fossilized cone impression (relief template embedded clearly within charcoal-tinted clay)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; needles must look like thick, rounded strips rather than razor-sharp spikes; wood features must have a solid, toy-like chunky structure; highlight the waxy, dark-green surface of the foliage.

visual_logic.composition: Quadrant composition: Top-Left: a detailed close-up of a flattened, comb-like needle arrangement; Top-Right: a solitary, hanging woody seed cone; Bottom-Left: a macro shot of a thick branch division node; Bottom-Right: a crisp fossil impression of a cone in dark charcoal clay.
visual_logic.ground: A clean layer of rusty ochre silt, elevating the dark greens and browns of the conifer specimens.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, high-key diffused light, highlighting the deep texture of the cone scales and the clean relief lines of the fossil.
